title: WEATHER FORECAST FOR 04 August 2026 Issued at 2.00 p.m. on 03 August 2026 Showers or thundershowers will occur at times in Western, Sabaragamuwa, and North-western provinces and Kandy, Nuwara Eliya, Galle and Matara districts. Heavy falls above 100 mm are likely at some places in Sabaragamuwa province and in Kandy and Nuwara-Eliya districts. Several spells of showers will occur in North-central province. Showers or thundershowers may occur at several places in Uva and Eastern provinces and in Mullaitivu district after 2.00 p.m. Strong winds of about (40-50) kmph can be expected at times over North-central, Sabaragamuwa, Southern, Central and North-western provinces and Trincomalee district. The general public is kindly requested to take adequate precautions to minimize damage caused by temporary localized strong winds and lightning during thundershowers.
